text: It's a great addition to a daily organizer or to-do-list, especially when you have ADHD (like me). You can set times or goals for tasks to minimize drifting off, or keep your progress in sight. I can still see room for improvement though (not sure if these are possible, but still); - Synchronisation with an Agenda app such as Google Calender or make a in app calender. - The ability to set task with a Completion box to tick. - Option to switch activities/categories position after creation.
author: Een Google-gebruiker
developer_reply: Thank you for the review! A lot of awesome things coming soon! Tick box actions and task ordering will be available in future versions!
